rationale: The approval constraint creates workflow-level obstruction, so the skill applies. Because the user left the outcome and modification authority unclear, Review was the correct maximum. The executor performed read-only inspection, made no writes, delivered evidence-backed findings, distinguished the requester-reported approval from observed file contents and derived risks, and kept its single recommendation bounded to the individual inspectability finding rather than defining an end-to-end approval workflow. The response appropriately identified missing context, ownership, handoff, and recovery without irrelevant analysis or unsupported validation claims.
